Plot a bl_projection biplot

plot.bl_projection.Rd

Renders the biplotEZ object stored in a "bl_projection" result. Default point colours are derived automatically:

  • CVA with TP/TN/FP/FN labels: green/steelblue/orange/red confusion colours.

  • CVA with binary 0/1 labels: red (class 1) / blue (class 0).

  • PCA (or any other case): red (class 1) / blue (class 0) when a "class" column was present in train_data; grey otherwise.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bl_projection'
plot(
  x,
  col = NULL,
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.8,
  axes_col = "grey22",
  tick_cex = 0.6,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A "bl_projection" object from bl_build_projection().

col

Character vector of point colours (one per training row). When NULL (default) the colours stored in x$point_col are used.

pch

Integer point character. Default 16.

cex

Numeric point size. Default 0.8.

axes_col

Colour for axis lines and labels. Default "grey22".

tick_cex

Numeric tick-label size. Default 0.6.

...

Ignored; present for S3 compatibility.

Value

Invisibly returns x.
